verdict.rationale: Secureframe has a documented risk management feature with a risk library, inherent/residual risk scoring, treatment recommendations, and justifications via Comply AI for Risk, and risks are tied to controls/frameworks per the platform's compliance model. However, evidence lacks detail on explicit risk owner assignment, defined review cycles/recurring reassessment schedules for risks (unlike the detailed review cadences shown for user access reviews and vendor risk), or a dedicated 'register' view with workflow status tracking. missing for 10: explicit owner assignment fields on risks, recurring review/reassessment scheduling for the risk register itself, and independent/hands-on confirmation of the register's depth.
